**💡 New Feature / Code Improvement**

Yo legend! My code is "kinda works" level, so any upgrade is huge. Grok helps me, but real humans are better :D

Heads-up: the website and apps are read-only for visitors on purpose — no accounts, no ads, no profiling, no telemetry in the apps. Features that would add those (or new cookies, or a new third-party service) need a chat in an issue first, since the Privacy Policy would have to change.

### What feature/improvement?
- [ ] Better scraping (more info, rating, etc.)
- [ ] Website/app UI (new page, filter, chart, better mobile layout)
- [ ] Desktop/Android app (Tauri)
- [ ] Automation (pipeline, GitHub Actions)
- [ ] Performance fix (faster pages, faster Actions)
- [ ] Refactor my messy code
- [ ] Other (describe)

### Description
Explain what it does and why it's cool. Include code snippets if needed.

### Related Issues
References # (link if any)

### Checklist
- [ ] Tested locally (Python: `pytest`, `ruff check scripts tests webapp/scripts`; webapp: `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run knip`, `npx tsc -b`)
- [ ] Doesn't break the daily refresh or the ingest workflow
- [ ] New npm dependency? Added it to `webapp/src/lib/about.ts` so the About page lists it
- [ ] Edited `webapp/wrangler.jsonc`? Ran `npm run cf:types`
- [ ] I agree my contribution is licensed under the MIT License (see `LICENSE`)
- [ ] Keeps the noob vibe intact

If this makes the repo less mediocre — you're the MVP. 🚀
